name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller 消息滚动区
description: 聊天记录滚动容器：跟随流式回复、加载历史不跳动、可跳转到任意消息。

whenToUse: 聊天记录：新回合锚定、跟随流式回复、加载更早消息时保持位置
打开保存的会话时定位到合适位置
accessibility: Viewport 默认 role=region、aria-label=消息、可聚焦；其他语言要改 aria-label
Content 为 role=log，新行会被朗读；流式输出时可传 aria-busy
MessageScroller.Button 无内容可滚时设为 inert，不占焦点
responsive: 填满父元素，必须放在有确定高度的容器内

files.content:
# Message Scroller 设计规范

- 结构为 `MessageScroller.Provider` > `MessageScroller.Root` > `MessageScroller.Viewport` > `MessageScroller.Content`，`MessageScroller.Button` 放在 Root 内；不要自己写聊天滚动逻辑。
- 它会填满父元素：放在高度受限的容器中（如 `flex h-screen flex-col` 里设 `flex-1`），否则无法滚动。
- `MessageScroller.Content` 的每个直接子元素都包一层 `MessageScroller.Item`，并设稳定的 `messageId`（消息 id，不要用数组下标）。
- 用 `scrollAnchor` 标记开启新一轮对话的行（通常是用户的消息），新一轮会停在视口上方并保留上一轮的一部分；输入提示、加载更多等行不要设为锚点。
- 不要自动滚到底部打断阅读；跳到指定消息用 `useMessageScroller` 提供的方法。

<script lang="ts">
	import { MessageScroller as MessageScrollerPrimitive } from "@valar/svelte-primitives/message-scroller";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: MessageScrollerPrimitive.ContentProps = $props();
</script>

<MessageScrollerPrimitive.Content
	bind:ref
	data-slot="message-scroller-content"
	class={cn("gap-6 flex h-max min-h-full flex-col", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { MessageScroller as MessageScrollerPrimitive } from "@valar/svelte-primitives/message-scroller";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		scrollAnchor = false,
		...restProps
	}: MessageScrollerPrimitive.ItemProps = $props();
</script>

<MessageScrollerPrimitive.Item
	bind:ref
	data-slot="message-scroller-item"
	{scrollAnchor}
	class={cn(
		"min-w-0 shrink-0 [contain-intrinsic-size:auto_10rem] [content-visibility:auto]",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { MessageScroller as MessageScrollerPrimitive } from "@valar/svelte-primitives/message-scroller";

	let { ...restProps }: MessageScrollerPrimitive.ProviderProps = $props();
</script>

<MessageScrollerPrimitive.Provider {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import { MessageScroller as MessageScrollerPrimitive } from "@valar/svelte-primitives/message-scroller";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		class: className,
		ref = $bindable(null),
		"aria-label": ariaLabel = "消息",
		...restProps
	}: MessageScrollerPrimitive.ViewportProps = $props();
</script>

<MessageScrollerPrimitive.Viewport
	bind:ref
	data-slot="message-scroller-viewport"
	aria-label={ariaLabel}
	class={cn(
		"size-full min-h-0 min-w-0 scroll-fade-b scrollbar-thin scrollbar-gutter-stable overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain contain-content data-autoscrolling:scrollbar-thumb-transparent data-autoscrolling:scrollbar-track-transparent data-pending-scroll:invisible",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { MessageScroller as MessageScrollerPrimitive } from "@valar/svelte-primitives/message-scroller";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		class: className,
		ref = $bindable(null),
		...restProps
	}: MessageScrollerPrimitive.RootProps = $props();
</script>

<MessageScrollerPrimitive.Root
	bind:ref
	data-slot="message-scroller"
	class={cn(
		"group/message-scroller relative flex size-full min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
/>
